channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Pentagon: Iran war cost exceeds $33.4 billion
item.description: A Pentagon report says the Iran war has cost the U.S. military at least $33.4 billion, mostly for munitions, excluding other agencies' spending.

item.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
item.description: NATO aircraft downed a drone in Lithuanian airspace during the overnight hours.

item.title: Ukrainian frontline city under fire as US pushes for peace
item.description: Kherson has been the frontline between Ukrainian and Russian forces in the south since its liberation in late 2022.

item.title: Ross Fire continues burning, over 90,000 acres scorched
item.description: The wildfire in Palo Pinto and Jack counties forced evacuations, closed roads and disrupted schools.
